dataset: mixed-emotion paragraph probe examples and precomputed token scores
authoring_method: Synthetic passages authored interactively with Codex for this experiment; no model-generation prompt was retained as a separate artifact.
annotation_scope: Sentence labels are intended primary/secondary cues for this synthetic probe design. They are pair-scoped annotations, not exhaustive emotion ground truth.
position_zero_policy: The score is preserved in JSONL but position zero is excluded from calibration and highlighting.
plot_calibration: For each emotion independently, q90 is the highlight threshold and q99.5 is full color saturation across all eligible tokens in all 24 records.
